description: This file defines an abstract class 'Operator' within the 'Matrix\Operators' namespace. It provides common functionality for matrix operations, including validation of matrix dimensions and storing matrix data. It serves as a base class for specific matrix operation implementations.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: An abstract base class for matrix operations, handling storage of matrices, validation of dimensions, and providing a result method to return the resulting matrix.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operator with a given Matrix object, storing its dimensions and array representation.

methods.name: validateMatchingDimensions
methods.description: Checks if the input matrix has matching dimensions for addition or subtraction operations; throws exception if dimensions do not match.

methods.name: validateReflectingDimensions
methods.description: Checks if the input matrix has compatible dimensions for multiplication/division; throws exception if dimensions do not align.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Returns a new Matrix object containing the result of the operation, based on the internal matrix data.
